semiconductor_relevance: Medium — CraftifAI provides AI-driven design services that enhance intelligent systems within the semiconductor value chain.
summary: CraftifAI develops an agentic AI platform that enhances intelligent systems, focusing on production-ready perception pipelines, embedded firmware, and FPGA designs.
